name: West End Musical
description: See a world-class musical in London's Theatreland. From long-running classics like Les Mis to the latest Broadway transfers.
tips: Check the TKTS booth in Leicester Square for same-day discounts up to 50% off. Matinees are usually cheaper.

name: Secret Cinema / Immersive Experience
description: London leads the world in immersive theatre. Step inside the story with experiences that blur the line between audience and performer.
tips: Check what's currently running. Punchdrunk, Secret Cinema, and The War of the Worlds are legendary producers.

name: Thames Dinner Cruise
description: A magical evening on the Thames, passing illuminated landmarks while enjoying a multi-course dinner and live entertainment.
tips: Perfect for a special occasion. Book a window table. The views of Parliament and Tower Bridge lit up at night are stunning.

name: Premier League Football Match
description: Experience the electric atmosphere of English football. London has more Premier League clubs than any other city.
tips: Arsenal, Chelsea, Tottenham, and West Ham are the main clubs. Stadium tours available on non-match days.

name: Traditional Afternoon Tea
description: A quintessentially British experience with finger sandwiches, scones with clotted cream, and delicate pastries served with fine tea.
tips: Top picks: The Ritz, Claridge's, The Savoy, Sketch. Book well ahead. Smart casual dress code.

name: The Comedy Store
description: London's most famous comedy venue in the heart of the West End. The Wednesday/Sunday Improv shows are legendary.
tips: The Comedy Store Players improv show (Wed & Sun) is the best value comedy in London.

name: Thames RIB Speedboat Experience
description: A thrilling high-speed boat ride down the Thames, blasting past London's iconic landmarks with James Bond-style commentary.
tips: Hold on tight! You will get splashed. Incredibly fun for all ages.

name: Wimbledon Tennis Museum & Tour
description: Go behind the scenes at the world's most famous tennis venue. See Centre Court, the dressing rooms, and the championship trophies.
tips: Available year-round except during the Championships. The 360° cinema experience of Centre Court is brilliant.

name: London Walking Tour
description: Explore London on foot with an expert guide. Options include Jack the Ripper, Harry Potter, Royal London, or ghost tours.
tips: Free walking tours operate on a tips basis. The Jack the Ripper tours in Whitechapel at night are atmospheric.

name: AIRE Ancient Baths
description: A luxurious thermal bath experience in a restored 600-year-old building. Candlelit pools, hot and cold baths, and massage treatments.
tips: Incredibly relaxing and romantic. The building itself is beautiful. Book the wine bath for a special treat.

name: Wembley Stadium Tour
description: Go behind the scenes at England's national stadium. Walk through the players' tunnel, sit in the Royal Box, and lift a replica trophy.
tips: Great for football fans of all ages. Check if any concerts or events are on during your visit.

name: Electric Cinema Notting Hill
description: One of the oldest working cinemas in the UK (1910). Luxurious leather armchairs, cashmere blankets, and a bar. Films with style.
tips: Book the double beds in the front row for the ultimate date night. Cocktails and snacks delivered to your seat.

name: Hampstead Heath Swimming Ponds
description: Wild swimming in London! Three natural swimming ponds on Hampstead Heath. A uniquely London experience.
tips: Open year-round! The mixed pond has the best views. Combine with a walk on the Heath. Cold but invigorating.

name: Arsenal Emirates Stadium Tour
description: Go behind the scenes at Arsenal's state-of-the-art Emirates Stadium. Visit the changing rooms, walk through the tunnel, and sit in Arsene Wenger's seat.
tips: The self-guided tour includes the museum with incredible memorabilia. Great for any football fan.

name: Chelsea Stamford Bridge Stadium Tour
description: Explore Chelsea FC's iconic home ground. See the dressing rooms, press room, and walk through the players' tunnel onto the pitch.
tips: The museum section covers Chelsea's entire history. Check if a match is on during your visit.

name: Lord's Cricket Ground Tour
description: Visit the 'Home of Cricket'. See the famous Long Room, the Ashes urn, and the futuristic Media Centre. A pilgrimage for cricket lovers.
address: St John's Wood Rd, London NW8 8QN
tips: The museum and the Long Room are the highlights. Combine with Abbey Road studios nearby.

name: Escape Room Experience
description: London has some of the world's best escape rooms. Work together to solve puzzles and escape before time runs out. Brilliant for groups.
tips: Top picks: The Crystal Maze LIVE, Escape Hunt, clueQuest. Book ahead — popular for groups and celebrations.

name: Cocktail Making Class
description: Learn to shake, stir, and muddle like a pro. A hands-on masterclass where you make (and drink!) 3-4 cocktails. Perfect for group celebrations.
tips: TT Liquor and London Cocktail Club are top picks. Amazing for hen parties, birthdays, and group celebrations.

name: Drag Brunch London
description: Bottomless brunch with spectacular drag performances, singalongs, and dancing. Outrageous fun and one of London's most joyful experiences.
tips: Hugely popular for hen parties and birthdays. Book well in advance. You will be pulled into the show!

name: Go Karting at TeamSport
description: High-speed indoor go karting on multi-level tracks. Competitive, adrenaline-fuelled fun perfect for group days out.
tips: The Tower Bridge and Bermondsey tracks are the best. Grand Prix packages available for groups.

name: Life Drawing Class
description: Try your hand at life drawing in a relaxed, social setting. Often combined with prosecco for hen parties and group events.
tips: Hen Life Drawing is the most popular for groups. No experience needed — it's about fun, not talent!

name: Pottery Workshop
description: Channel your inner Ghost movie scene with a hands-on pottery throwing class. Great fun for groups and couples alike.
tips: Turning Earth and ClayMotion are top picks. Your creation gets fired and posted to you. Book ahead.

name: Axe Throwing Experience
description: Urban axe throwing in a safe, supervised environment. Surprisingly satisfying and addictive. Great competitive fun for groups.
tips: Whistle Punks is the top venue. Instructors teach you — no experience needed. Perfect for stag dos.

name: Hot Tub Boat on the Thames
description: A wood-fired hot tub on a boat cruising the Thames. Soak in warm water while passing London's most iconic landmarks. Surreal and brilliant.
tips: Bring swimwear and a sense of adventure. You can BYO drinks. Fits up to 7 people — perfect for groups.

name: London Helicopter Tour
description: See London from above on a thrilling helicopter flight over the city's most iconic landmarks. A once-in-a-lifetime experience.
tips: Perfect for proposals, anniversaries, and milestone birthdays. 12-15 minute flights. Book well in advance.

name: Lucky Voice Karaoke
description: Private karaoke rooms with cocktails and a catalogue of thousands of songs. The best group activity in London for letting loose.
tips: Private rooms so no public embarrassment! The cocktails are great. Perfect for birthdays and celebrations.

name: London Gin Distillery Tour & Tasting
description: Visit a working London gin distillery, learn about the craft, and taste several gins. Some offer 'make your own gin' experiences.
tips: Sipsmith, Beefeater, and Bermondsey's Jensen's are top picks. The 'make your own bottle' experiences are brilliant group activities.

name: Wicked
description: The blockbuster musical telling the untold story of the Witches of Oz. Spectacular staging, soaring songs, and a beloved cast at the Apollo Victoria.
address: Apollo Victoria Theatre, 17 Wilton Rd, London SW1V 1LG
tips: Running since 2006 and still selling out. Try the lottery for discounted front-row seats. Stalls offer the best views.

name: Hamilton
description: The revolutionary hip-hop musical about Alexander Hamilton. A genre-defining theatrical experience that took the world by storm.
address: Victoria Palace Theatre, Victoria St, London SW1E 5EA
tips: Enter the daily lottery for a chance at tickets. The Victoria Palace Theatre was beautifully restored for this show.

name: The Lion King
description: Disney's spectacular musical with jaw-dropping puppetry and Julie Taymor's iconic staging. A magical experience for all ages running since 1999.
address: Lyceum Theatre, 21 Wellington St, London WC2E 7RQ
tips: The opening Circle of Life number alone is worth the ticket price. Best viewed from the dress circle for full puppet effect.

name: The Phantom of the Opera
description: Andrew Lloyd Webber's Gothic masterpiece and the longest-running musical in West End history. The chandelier crash remains thrilling.
address: His Majesty's Theatre, Haymarket, London SW1Y 4QR
tips: The theatre itself is stunning. Stalls seats give the best experience of the chandelier scene. A true London classic.

name: Les Miserables
description: The epic musical about revolution, redemption, and love in 19th-century France. Running in the West End since 1985 with a stunning new staging.
address: Sondheim Theatre, 51 Shaftesbury Ave, London W1D 6BA
tips: The new staging since 2019 is spectacular. Do not leave before the full company finale. Tissues recommended.

name: Matilda the Musical
description: Roald Dahl's beloved story brought to life with Tim Minchin's brilliant score. Anarchic, funny, and heartwarming in equal measure.
address: Cambridge Theatre, Earlham St, London WC2H 9HU
tips: Perfect for families but adults love it too. The child performers are extraordinary. Stalls centre for best views.

name: Back to the Future: The Musical
description: The beloved time-travel film adapted for the stage with a flying DeLorean, spectacular effects, and all the iconic movie moments.
tips: The DeLorean on stage is incredible. Great for nostalgia fans. The Adelphi Theatre has excellent sightlines.

name: Moulin Rouge! The Musical
description: A theatrical celebration of truth, beauty, freedom, and love. Dazzling visuals, pop mashups, and the Piccadilly Theatre transformed into the iconic club.
address: Piccadilly Theatre, 16 Denman St, London W1D 7DY
tips: The theatre transformation is astonishing. Dress circle gives the full visual impact. A sensory overload in the best way.

name: The Crystal Maze LIVE Experience
description: Step into the legendary Crystal Maze TV show. Race through four themed zones solving physical and mental challenges as a team.
tips: Teams of 8 are ideal. Wear comfortable clothing. The Crystal Dome finale is just as chaotic as on TV.

name: Jeff Wayne's The War of the Worlds: The Immersive Experience
description: A mind-blowing VR and live-action immersive experience based on the iconic musical. Walk through the Martian invasion with cutting-edge technology.
tips: The VR sections are genuinely thrilling. Cocktail bar included. Allow about 2 hours for the full experience.

name: Monopoly Lifesized
description: A giant, interactive, real-life version of the classic board game. Move around a life-sized board completing challenges to buy properties.
tips: Great for families and competitive friend groups. The challenges are physical and mental. Allow 90 minutes.

name: Tottenham Hotspur Stadium Tour
description: Tour one of Europe's newest and most impressive stadiums. See the Sky Walk, the tunnel, changing rooms, and the retractable pitch.
tips: The Sky Walk across the roof is a separate ticketed experience for thrill-seekers. Newest Premier League stadium in London.

name: Twickenham Stadium & World Rugby Museum
description: Tour the home of English rugby. Walk through the tunnel, visit the dressing rooms, and explore the World Rugby Museum's incredible collection.
tips: The museum covers the full history of rugby. Match day experiences are incredible if you can get tickets.

name: The Oval Cricket Ground Tour
description: Tour the historic home of Surrey County Cricket Club. See the famous pavilion, Long Room, and enjoy views from the top of the OCS Stand.
tips: Test match cricket at The Oval is a quintessentially English summer experience. The atmosphere on day five is electric.

name: QPR Match Day at Loftus Road
description: Experience authentic London football at QPR's intimate Loftus Road ground. A traditional English football atmosphere far from the tourist trail.
tips: One of London's most atmospheric small grounds. Tickets much easier to get than Premier League clubs. Genuine local experience.

name: Crystal Palace FC Match Day
description: Watch Crystal Palace at Selhurst Park with its legendary atmosphere. The ultras section creates one of the best matchday experiences in London.
address: Selhurst Park, Whitehorse Ln, London SE25 6PU
tips: The Holmesdale Fanatics create incredible atmosphere. More accessible tickets than the Big Six clubs. A proper football experience.

name: Cooking Class at Borough Market
description: Hands-on cooking class using fresh ingredients from London's most famous food market. Learn to cook seasonal British and international dishes.
tips: Browse the market before class and source your own ingredients. Bread Ahead bakery school does excellent bread and pastry classes.

name: Bread Ahead Baking Class
description: Learn to bake doughnuts, sourdough, or pastries at this famous Borough Market bakery school. Hands-on, fun, and delicious.
address: Borough Market, Cathedral St, London SE1 9DE
tips: The doughnut class is the most popular. You take home everything you bake. Book well in advance — they sell out fast.

name: London Wine Tasting Experience
description: Guided wine tasting in atmospheric cellars and bars across London. From beginner introductions to masterclasses in specific regions.
tips: Vinopolis under the railway arches and Gordon's Wine Bar are atmospheric choices. WSET courses for serious learners.

name: Thames Lunch Cruise
description: A leisurely lunch cruise along the Thames passing all the major landmarks. A relaxing way to see London from the water with a two-course meal.
tips: More affordable than the dinner cruise and the views are arguably better in daylight. Runs year-round.

name: Thames Afternoon Tea Cruise
description: Enjoy a traditional afternoon tea while cruising past the Houses of Parliament, Tower Bridge, and the City skyline. Quintessentially British.
tips: A lovely alternative to hotel afternoon teas. The views add magic. Booking essential on weekends.

name: London Ghost Tour
description: Explore London's most haunted locations after dark. Visit plague pits, haunted pubs, and hear chilling tales of ghosts and ghouls.
tips: Best on dark winter evenings. The City of London has the most atmospheric ghost stories. Not suitable for young children.

name: Jack the Ripper Walking Tour
description: Follow in the footsteps of history's most infamous serial killer through the atmospheric streets of Whitechapel. Expert guides bring the story to life.
tips: Evening tours are much more atmospheric. Many companies run this tour — look for ones with published historians as guides.

name: Harry Potter Walking Tour
description: Visit real London filming locations from the Harry Potter films including Leadenhall Market (Diagon Alley), Platform 9 3/4, and the Leaky Cauldron.
tips: Different from the Warner Bros Studio Tour. This covers actual London filming locations. Platform 9 3/4 at King's Cross is the highlight.

name: Beatles London Walking Tour
description: Walk in the footsteps of the Fab Four through London. Visit Abbey Road, the Apple Records building, and locations from their iconic album covers.
address: Tottenham Court Road Station, London W1T
tips: Recreate the iconic Abbey Road crossing photo. The tour covers Soho, Marylebone, and St John's Wood. Essential for music lovers.

name: Shoreditch Street Art Tour
description: Explore London's ever-changing street art scene with a local guide. See works by Banksy, Stik, and dozens of international artists in Shoreditch.
address: Shoreditch High St Station, London E1 6JJ
tips: The art changes constantly so every tour is different. Great for photography. Some tours let you try spray painting yourself.

name: London Eye at Night
description: See London illuminated from the iconic observation wheel. A 30-minute rotation with spectacular views of Big Ben, the Thames, and the glittering skyline.
address: Riverside Building, County Hall, London SE1 7PB
tips: Night rides are more magical than daytime. Book a Champagne Experience for an extra-special occasion. Skip-the-line tickets save time.

name: Madame Tussauds London
description: The world's most famous wax museum with lifelike figures of celebrities, royals, sports stars, and historical figures. Interactive zones and a Marvel 4D experience.
tips: Book online in advance for big savings over walk-up prices. First thing in the morning or late afternoon is least crowded.

name: The View from The Shard
description: London's highest public viewing gallery at 244 metres. Panoramic views stretching up to 40 miles on a clear day from Western Europe's tallest building.
tips: Sunset tickets are most popular — book well ahead. The open-air observation deck on level 72 is exhilarating.

name: Up at The O2
description: Climb over the roof of The O2 arena on a guided expedition. Walk up a tensile fabric walkway to a viewing platform at the summit with panoramic views.
tips: Sunset and twilight climbs are the most spectacular. You are harnessed in so it is safe but still thrilling. Wear flat shoes.

name: Zip Line Across the Thames
description: Fly across the Thames on a thrilling zip line at speeds up to 50km/h. Stunning views of the O2, Canary Wharf, and the Royal Docks.
tips: Book in advance as slots go fast in summer. The ride is short but the thrill is real. Combine with Up at The O2.

name: Bungee Jump at The O2
description: A 160ft bungee jump from a crane at the O2. London's only permanent bungee jumping experience with views of the Thames and Canary Wharf.
tips: Video and photos available to purchase. Minimum age 14. Walk-ins sometimes available but book ahead to guarantee your slot.

name: Castle Climbing Centre
description: Indoor rock climbing in a spectacular converted Victorian water pumping station. Walls up to 12m high with routes for all abilities.
tips: The building itself is incredible. Beginner sessions available. One of London's most unique sports venues.

name: The Wave Indoor Surfing
description: Ride an indoor wave machine in central London. Lessons for complete beginners through to experienced surfers. A unique London activity.
tips: No experience needed — instructors guide you. Swimwear provided if needed. Surprisingly tiring but incredibly fun.

name: Oxygen Free Jumping Trampoline Park
description: Massive indoor trampoline park with interconnected trampolines, foam pits, dodgeball courts, and a ninja warrior course.
tips: Grip socks required (can buy there). Off-peak sessions are cheaper. Great for kids' parties and rainy days.

name: Tower Bridge Exhibition
description: Walk inside the iconic Tower Bridge, cross the glass floor walkways 42 metres above the Thames, and visit the original Victorian Engine Rooms.
tips: The glass floor walkway is thrilling. Check the bridge lift times on the website and visit to see it open.

name: Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew
description: UNESCO World Heritage Site with the world's largest collection of living plants. Spectacular glasshouses, a treetop walkway, and beautiful gardens year-round.
address: Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, Richmond TW9 3AE
tips: The Palm House and Temperate House are architectural marvels. The Treetop Walkway gives aerial views. Allow a full day.

name: Ronnie Scott's Jazz Club
description: London's legendary jazz club in Soho, hosting world-class jazz since 1959. An intimate, atmospheric venue that has hosted every jazz great.
tips: Late shows are cheaper than main shows. The atmosphere is intimate and special. Book dinner to get the best tables.

name: Thames Jet Ultimate London Adventure
description: A 50-minute speedboat blasting down the Thames at 35 knots. High-speed thrills past every major London landmark.
tips: Longer and faster than the RIB speedboat. You will get very wet in the front. Waterproof jackets provided.

name: London Food Tour
description: A guided walking food tour through London's best food neighbourhoods. Taste your way through Borough Market, Brick Lane, Soho, or East London.
tips: Come hungry! The Borough Market tour is the most popular. East End tours cover incredible multicultural food. Secret Food Tours is well-rated.

name: Historic London Pub Tour
description: Visit some of London's oldest and most atmospheric pubs with a guide who brings their incredible histories to life. Includes tastings.
tips: Pubs dating back to the 1600s with incredible tales. Ye Olde Cheshire Cheese and The Lamb and Flag are highlights.

name: Hampton Court Palace
description: Henry VIII's magnificent Tudor palace with stunning gardens, the famous maze, and 500 years of royal history. A full day trip from central London.
address: Hampton Court Palace, East Molesey KT8 9AU
tips: The maze is a must-do. The Tudor kitchens are fascinating. Take the river boat from Westminster for a scenic journey.

name: West Ham United at London Stadium
description: Watch West Ham at the former Olympic Stadium in Stratford. A modern matchday experience in the iconic London 2012 venue.
address: London Stadium, Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park, London E20 2ST
tips: The Olympic Park area has lots to do before the match. More available tickets than Arsenal or Chelsea. Accessible by DLR and tube.

name: Somerset House Events
description: Stunning neoclassical building hosting rotating exhibitions, film screenings, live music, and seasonal events including an ice rink in winter.
tips: Check what is currently showing. Summer live music series and winter ice rink are highlights. The courtyard fountains are iconic.

name: Thames Boat to Greenwich
description: Take a scenic Thames Clipper to historic Greenwich. Visit the Cutty Sark, Royal Observatory, and stand on the Prime Meridian line.
address: Greenwich Pier, King William Walk, London SE10 9HT
tips: Use a Thames Clipper with Oyster/contactless for cheap river travel. The view from the Royal Observatory is outstanding.

name: Soho Stand-Up Comedy Night
description: Catch emerging and established comedians at one of Soho's intimate comedy clubs. A perfect pre-dinner or late-night entertainment option.
tips: Top of the Spots, Soho Theatre, and 99 Club are great choices. Many clubs offer free or cheap early shows.

name: London Night Bus Tour
description: See London illuminated on an open-top bus tour after dark. Pass Buckingham Palace, Tower Bridge, St Paul's, and Big Ben all lit up.
tips: Sit on the top deck for the best views. Wrap up warm even in summer. Runs rain or shine — it is magical in any weather.

name: The London Dungeon
description: Interactive horror attraction bringing London's darkest history to life with live actors, special effects, and rides. From the plague to Jack the Ripper.
address: Riverside Building, County Hall, London SE1 7PB
tips: Not suitable for very young children. Book online for significant savings. The drop ride at the end is a surprise.
